actions.description: Advance the simulated world by a bounded number of fixed timesteps, optionally applying an action for each step, and return the resulting observation and terminal flags.

inputs.description: Transitions to advance; the action is applied at every tick
inputs.name: ticks

inputs.description: The action applied at each tick, shaped by the environment's action space
inputs.name: action

actions.name: step

actions.description: Reset the simulated world to a scenario start state and return the initial observation. When a seed is supplied the endpoint records it in the receipt; otherwise the endpoint's declared default seed applies.

inputs.description: Seed of the environment's random generator
inputs.name: seed

actions.name: reset

actions.description: Set the seed used by the simulated world's random number generators for subsequent steps, without resetting the world. The accepted seed is echoed in the receipt.

inputs.description: Seed used by the next reset
inputs.name: seed

facts.text: SoArm-v0 is registered with entry point gym_soarm.env:SoArmAlohaEnv, max_episode_steps 200, and defaults task pick_place, obs_type pixels_agent_pos, render_mode rgb_array and camera_config front_wrist
The environment declares render modes rgb_array and human and render_fps 50
The action space is a Box of six absolute joint positions for shoulder_pan, shoulder_lift, elbow_flex, wrist_flex, wrist_roll and gripper

The joint limits are shoulder_pan -1.91986 to 1.91986, shoulder_lift -1.74533 to 1.74533, elbow_flex -1.69 to 1.69, wrist_flex -1.65806 to 1.65806, wrist_roll -2.74385 to 2.84121 and gripper -0.17453 to 1.74533
The joint angles are in radians: the start-pose comment says in radians and the README displays joint angles in radians
The simulation timestep is DT = 0.02 s (50 Hz)
The dm_control Environment is created with control_timestep=DT and an infinite time limit
The starting arm pose is [0.0, 0.0, -1.57, 0.0, 0.0, 0.0] radians
The gripper observation is normalized to [0, 1] with 0 closed and 1 open: (x - (-0.17453)) / (1.74533 - (-0.17453))
The agent_pos observation is the five arm joint positions followed by the normalized gripper position
The observation types are state (6 joint positions, 6 velocities, end-effector position and quaternion), pixels (a Dict of camera images) and pixels_agent_pos (pixels plus 6 joint positions)
camera_config front_wrist includes front_camera and wrist_camera; the four accepted values are front_only, front_wrist, diagonal_wrist and all
The task renders four camera images at height 480 and width 640: front_camera, wrist_camera, diagonal_camera and overview_camera
A reset seeds the task random generators with the given seed
PickPlaceTask.initialize_episode draws the cube placement from a time-based seed, so the reset seed does not make the pick_place placement repeatable
The reset options accept cube_grid_position 0 to 8, -1 with cube_x and cube_y for custom coordinates, or None for random placement, and values outside the grid range raise ValueError
The blue cube grid is 3x3 around table centre (0.0, 0.4) with +-0.10 m in x and +-0.075 m in y, at z = 0.05 m
The goal plate starts at (-0.2, 0.4, 0.05) in the scene model
step clips the action to the joint limits before it advances the dm_control physics
SoArmAlohaEnv.step always returns truncated=False
An episode terminates when the blue cube is within 10 mm of the goal plate
The pick_place reward is 1 - d / 1.0, clipped to 0, where d is the Euclidean distance between the forward-kinematics end-effector position and the blue cube, and the reward is 0 beyond 1.0 m
The forward kinematics maps the first five joint angles to the end-effector position with the SO-ARM101 link offsets
The environment depends on mujoco, gymnasium, dm-control and imageio
The task module imports torch, lerobot and a .reward_wrapper module

determinism.notes: the fake's cube placement and joint model are deterministic for one seed and action sequence; the upstream PickPlaceTask samples the cube from the wall clock (sim.py:246-249), so the upstream reset is not reproducible in the same way

gaps: kinematic stand-in: each joint moves toward the requested position by a bounded placeholder delta per tick; there is no dynamics, contact, friction, actuator, sensor or noise model, and the upstream dm_control/MuJoCo physics (pyproject.toml:23-25) was not run
the camera observations are 2x2x3 placeholder frames; the real environment renders 480x640x3 per camera (sim.py:188-192), and the stand-in frames carry no scene content

the blue cube stays where reset placed it because there is no contact or grasping model, so termination occurs only when a reset places the cube on the goal plate; the stacking task is not modelled by the fake
no wall-clock pacing: realtime_factor 0, and ticks advance simulated time by timestep_ms only
no physical device is modelled and the model was never validated against one
snapshot and restore are not offered: the environment exposes no get_state or set_state
the clone itself is not importable here: tasks/sim.py imports torch, lerobot and a missing reward_wrapper module (sim.py:1-16), so the upstream sim backend was not run

measures.description: Last observation (derived from the observation space)
measures.name: observation

safe_state.description: the simulation stops advancing: no step or reset is accepted after an e-stop until mhs.safety.reset clears the latch; the last observation stays readable
